method.base_rate: a signal must exceed the window's overall growth by 25 points; a category holding more than 60% of the window is excluded. Normalisation applies only when the previous window holds at least 10 incidents.
method.confidence: 55% sample size + 25% multi-source corroboration + 20% field completeness
method.exposure: median and 90th percentile only; volumes are mostly claimed and never summed
method.signal_rule: minimum 3 incidents and +2 delta; acceleration requires >=50% increase; new threat-sector pairs require >=3 incidents
method.warning: Observed publication patterns are not estimates of true cyber incident prevalence.
